svg.title: Two-mode energy contours and Hessian-classified stationary states at loads 74 and 80.
svg.desc: English: Two-mode energy contours and Hessian-classified stationary states at loads 74 and 80. 繁體中文：負載 74 與 80 的兩模態能量等高線及 Hessian 分類平衡態。

cc:Work.dc:description: The saved ZIP M=2 energy landscapes at loads 74 and 80, with every signed stationary state from the independent certified low-dimensional census. Coordinates are sine-Galerkin coefficients, not measured beam positions. Filled contours evaluate the independently explicit quartic polynomial using the saved C=4, S=1, zero-phase model; exact grid arrays and root-energy agreement checks are preserved with this figure. Circles denote strict minima, crosses Morse-index-1 saddles, and plus signs index-2 states. Contour lines are energy levels, not transition paths. The two panels use their own energy scales, and their roots must not be promoted to physical equilibria solely from numerical convergence.
